title: Core: Undo/redo history depth limit
description: Verify the useHistory hook in packages/authoring-ui/src/hooks/useHistory.ts has a max history depth. Flash 8 supports up to 100 undo levels by default. Add a maxDepth parameter (default 100) and test that pushing 101 items drops the oldest. Also verify undo/redo at boundaries (at start, at end) are no-ops.
